app.name: Mirador
app.tagline: Your money, private and in your hands.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.intro: Your password unlocks your data on this device. It never leaves it.
signIn.passkey: Sign in with Face ID or a passkey

signUp.title: Create your account
signUp.intro: Your password encrypts your data on this device. The server never sees it, so nobody can reset it for you.
signUp.usernameHint: 3 to 32 letters, numbers, dots, dashes or underscores. It doesn't need to be your real name.
signUp.passwordHint: At least {{count}} characters, with an uppercase letter, a lowercase letter, a number and a symbol.
signUp.setupCodeHint: This server has no accounts yet. The person who runs it finds the setup code in the server's log.
signUp.inviteCodeHint: This server takes new accounts by invite only. The code is in the link you were sent; if you have none, ask the person who runs the server.

recoveryKey.title: Save your recovery key
recoveryKey.intro: If you forget your password, this key is the only way back into your data. It's shown only this once.
recoveryKey.warning: If you lose both your password and this key, your data is gone for good. Nobody can recover it, not even the person who runs the server.
recoveryKey.label: Recovery key
recoveryKey.confirm: I saved my recovery key somewhere safe

unlock.title: Unlock Mirador
unlock.intro: Your data is encrypted. Enter your password to open it on this device.
unlock.introPasskey: Your data is encrypted. Use Face ID, a passkey or your password to open it on this device.
unlock.passkey: Unlock with Face ID or a passkey

recover.title: Recover your account
recover.intro: Your recovery key opens your data and sets a new password. Every other device will be signed out.
recover.recoveryKeyHint: The key you saved when you created your account. Spaces and dashes don't matter.
recover.working: Opening your data with the recovery key…

home.encrypted: Your data is end-to-end encrypted. Only this device can read it while it's unlocked.

username.title: Username
username.intro: You sign in as {{username}}. A new username keeps your password, passkeys and data as they are.
username.done: Username changed. Sign in as {{username}} from now on.

password.title: Password
password.intro: Your password unlocks your data. Changing it signs out your other devices, and your data stays as it is.
password.done: Password changed. Your other devices were signed out.

recoveryKey.title: Recovery key
recoveryKey.intro: Make a new recovery key if you lost yours or someone else may have seen it. The old one stops working at once.
recoveryKey.done: Your new recovery key is saved. The old one no longer works.

devices.title: Other devices
devices.intro: Sign out every other phone, tablet or computer. This one stays signed in.
devices.done_zero: No other devices were signed in.

passkeys.title: Passkeys and Face ID
passkeys.intro: Unlock and sign in with Face ID, a fingerprint or your device's PIN instead of typing your password. Your password keeps working.
passkeys.name: Passkey {{number}}
passkeys.done: Passkey added. Next time, unlock with it.
passkeys.unsupported: This browser can't use passkeys. Try Safari on an iPhone or Chrome on Android.

autoLock.title: Lock automatically
autoLock.intro: Mirador locks itself when you stop using it, and asks for your password, Face ID or passkey again. This setting is for this device only.
autoLock.label: Lock
autoLock.leave: As soon as I leave the app

invites.title: Invites
invites.intro: Only people you invite can create an account on this server. Make an invite link and send it to them yourself. Each link works once, for {{count}} days.
invites.shareText: Track your expenses and plan your future with Mirador Budget:
invites.shownOnce: Send this link now: it is shown only once. If you lose it, withdraw the invite and make another.

errors.username-taken: That username is taken. Pick another.
errors.wrong-setup-code: That setup code is wrong. Check the server's log for the current one.
errors.signed-out: You were signed out. Sign in again.
errors.locked: Mirador is locked. Unlock it with your password.
errors.too-many-attempts: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
errors.unsafe-server: The server sent keys, settings or data that aren't safe, so Mirador stopped. Your password was not sent.
errors.network: Can't reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
errors.invalidUsername: Use 3 to 32 letters, numbers, dots, dashes or underscores, with no spaces.
errors.passwordRules: Use at least {{count}} characters, with an uppercase letter, a lowercase letter, a number and a symbol.
errors.recovery-key-typo: That recovery key has a typo. Check each group of four characters.
errors.wrong-invite: That invite code is wrong, already used or expired. Ask for a new one.
errors.wrong-passkey: That passkey isn't one of this account's, or it was removed. Use your password instead.
errors.passkey-unsupported: This passkey can't unlock encrypted data. Use one saved in iCloud Keychain, Google Password Manager or another passkey app that supports it.
errors.passkey-cancelled: The passkey wasn't used. Try again when you're ready.
errors.too-many-passkeys: This account already has as many passkeys as it can. Remove one first.
